# Book A Sloth

> Book A Sloth is an India-first appointment-booking platform for creators and professionals — coaches, tutors, consultants, designers, wellness practitioners and more (called "hosts"). Hosts publish services, share one short booking link, and get paid up-front at **0% commission**. Guests book in seconds via OTP or a free account; payments run through Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking).

Key facts:

- **0% commission** — hosts keep 100% of what they earn.
- **Plans:** Free (Starter), Creator ₹199/mo, Pro ₹499/mo — annual billing available at a discount.
- **India-native:** INR pricing, GST handling and UPI built in.
- **Runs the whole booking:** payments up-front, email + WhatsApp reminders, two-way Google Calendar sync, and auto-generated video-call links.
- **Personal page:** every host gets `bookasloth.com/their-username` — a mini-site that books, bills and brands them.
- Positioned as a calmer, India-first alternative to tools like Topmate and Calendly.

## Notes for crawlers

- Host profiles are public and live at `https://bookasloth.com/{username}`. The full, always-current list is in the [sitemap](https://bookasloth.com/sitemap.xml).
- Private app surfaces — host dashboard, admin, and sign-in/sign-up flows — are not intended for indexing or training (see [robots.txt](https://bookasloth.com/robots.txt)).
